reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and threads it through every caller, but writes the daily 'excluded day' test inline instead of a shared predicate.

duplication.why: The 'weekend or holiday' predicate is written three times (two loops in getNextDate and once in getDatesInRange), on top of the existing duplicated daily-skip logic.

placement.why: The date-moving rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the weekend logic already was; the daily holiday check is spread into server/schedules/app.ts.

scope.why: Focused on the feature, with one unrelated reformatting of an existing test in app.test.ts.

maintainability.why: The shift logic is cleanly generalised, but the daily skip rule now has three inline copies, one of which (getDatesInRange) applies a different guard (skipWeekend only for holidays), making divergence likely.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All shift sites call getDateWithSkippedWeekend with the new holidays argument.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated isWeekend || holidays.includes(dayFromDate(...)) checks in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange are visible inline copies, not disguised.

one_place.where: Moving a date lands in getDateWithSkippedWeekend (shared/schedules.ts), but the daily skip rule is decided separately in two loops in getNextDate and in getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) with a different condition.
